svg.aria-label: How a pass tells whether a client is attached. The kernel's socket table answers first: a connection with an open other end means attached, no connection means no client. When the table cannot tell, zellij's list-clients is asked, one session at a time. When that gives no answer, zellij's count in its metadata file can add a client. When nothing can tell, the session is kept as uncertain.
